description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Bailiff demo, step 4): appeal the return order with optional reasons (up to 1,000 characters). Atlas attaches its counterargument and refers the appeal to an independently vested Magistrate. No engine read is made. Until a vested Magistrate decides, the result is DEEP_REVIEW_PENDING: Demonstration result, not decided by any Magistrate. The order stays in force during the appeal. One appeal per copy. Demonstration on a synthetic practice matter; not certified; binds only this practice copy.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.
